narrative: (Policyholder with AAMI home insurance.) On 3 February 2024 there was heavy rain and the creek near our house broke its banks, flooding our backyard and getting into the garage. The garage floor was under about 20cm of water and it ruined a chest freezer and a bunch of boxes we had stored on the floor. We think it'll cost around $2,500 to replace the freezer and the stuff that got wet.

(Policyholder with Allianz home insurance.) On 14 August 2023 our washing machine hose burst overnight and flooded the laundry, spreading water into the hallway and adjoining bedroom. By morning the laundry vinyl flooring was lifting, the hallway carpet was soaked through, and the bedroom skirting boards had started swelling. My policy number is HC-4489213 and I think the repairs could run to around $6,500.

(Policyholder with NRMA home insurance.) On 9 February 2024 I woke up to find someone had spray-painted graffiti all over our front fence and garage door overnight. It looks like it happened while we were asleep since there was nothing there when we went to bed. I haven't had anyone come out to quote on repainting or replacing the panels yet, so I don't have a cost figure at this stage.

(Policyholder with RAA home insurance.) On 3 February 2023 heavy rain caused the creek behind our property to overflow and water came into our home, ruining the carpets in the living room and soaking the bottom of the plasterboard walls. It happened really fast, within about an hour the water was ankle deep inside. We've had to rip up the carpet already because it started smelling. I think it'll cost around $9,000 to fix the flooring and walls.

(Policyholder with RealInsurance home insurance.) On 14 February 2024, someone broke into our shed and stole my husband's mountain bike. We noticed it missing when he went to get it for his ride the next morning and found the shed padlock cut. The bike was worth around $2,200. Our policy number is HOM-4471203.

(Policyholder with AAMI home insurance.) On 3 August 2023 we had an electrical fault in the laundry that started a small fire, and it spread faster than I expected before I could put it out. The washing machine, dryer, and the wall cabinetry all got badly burnt, and the ceiling and part of the hallway carpet were damaged by smoke and heat. My policy number is HM-559213. I haven't gotten quotes yet but I'd guess it's around $14,000 to fix everything.

(Policyholder with Allianz home insurance.) On 3 August 2023, our clothes dryer caught fire while running in the laundry and scorched the wall and cabinetry beside it. I managed to put it out with a fire extinguisher before it spread further. My policy number is HM-2298471. I'd estimate the damage to be around $2,800 to repair.

(Policyholder with NRMA home insurance.) On 3 February 2024 a candle I left burning on the lounge room shelf tipped over and caught the curtains on fire. The flames spread quickly and scorched part of the wall and carpet before I managed to put it out with a wet towel. I haven't had anyone come look at the damage yet so I don't know what it'll cost to fix. My policy number is HC-882913.

(Policyholder with RAA home insurance.) On 3 September 2023 I woke up to find my front fence and letterbox spray painted with some kind of symbol, and one of the timber palings had been kicked in. I'm not sure exactly when it happened overnight, and I didn't hear anything, but it definitely wasn't like that when I went to bed. My policy number is HM-773245 and I'd guess it'll cost around $850 to repaint and replace the paling.

(Policyholder with RealInsurance home insurance.) On 3 February 2024 a cricket ball hit by kids playing in the street smashed one of our large front windows. Glass shattered onto the living room floor but thankfully no one was hurt. I've boarded it up for now but haven't had a glazier come out to quote the replacement yet.

(Policyholder with AAMI home insurance.) On 11 November 2024 I noticed the mortar joints around my brick chimney had deteriorated badly and several bricks had become loose. The mason said the mortar has gradually broken down with age and needs to be repointed and repaired. I have not been given a final price yet.

(Policyholder with Allianz home insurance.) On 16 February 2024 I noticed new cracks running through the brickwork and internal walls on the western side of my house. A builder has advised that the ground beneath that part of the house has subsided and the footings have moved. I have been quoted approximately $12,500 for the repairs.

(Policyholder with NRMA home insurance.) On 12 August 2023 we came home from a weekend away to find our back sliding door forced open and the house ransacked. They took my husband's laptop, my jewellery box with my engagement ring and grandmother's necklace, and a PlayStation 5 with several games. Our policy number is HM2287451. We haven't had a chance to get a full quote yet but I'd estimate it's all worth around $9,500.

(Policyholder with RAA home insurance.) On 8 February 2024 my son was kicking a soccer ball in the backyard and it smashed straight through our sliding glass door. The whole pane shattered and we've had to board it up until it can be replaced. I think it'll cost around $650 to fix.

(Policyholder with RealInsurance home insurance.) On 14 March 2024 the flexible hose under my kitchen sink burst while I was at work, and by the time I got home water had flooded the cabinetry and part of the timber flooring. I've had to pull out the swollen cabinet base and the floorboards are warped. My policy number is HM-2298471. I'm hoping to get quotes but think it will cost around $4,500 to fix.

Our hot water pipes are corroded from years of use and finally started leaking under the house, causing rot to the bearers. This has clearly been building up gradually over the last several years, not a sudden event.
Something happened to our house last month and there is some damage we noticed. We are not sure of the cause or how much it will cost to fix.
A king tide combined with storm surge pushed sea water up over our beachfront property, flooding the ground floor and ruining the flooring and skirting boards. Repair estimate is ,000.

Heavy rain caused the river behind our property to break its banks and flood our backyard shed, destroying tools and equipment worth about ,000. Our policy documents were unclear on whether this counts as flood or storm cover when we called the insurer.

A break-in occurred at our home on 2025-07-10 and the thief stole jewellery and electronics. We do not have receipts, but we estimate the total loss at ,000, which is well above what we believe our policy sub-limits allow for unspecified valuables.
